node.statement: For x=(A,B), y=(C,D) in M_n(C^2), bilinearity alone gives the exact four-term identity v_n(x)v_n(y)-v_n(xy)=AC tensor(q_1^2-q_1)+AD tensor(q_1q_2)+BC tensor(q_2q_1)+BD tensor(q_2^2-q_2). Using node 1.4, ||RS||<=||R||*||S|| for scalar matrices, and ||(A,B)||=max{||A||,||B||}, its norm is at most 4d||x||||y||. Together with the exact linearity and involution preservation in node 1.3, every v_n is a non-unital 4d-homomorphism, with a defect independent of n.
